title: Provide JSON-Editor with component to view/render location data

comments_data.body: Don't merge this. But, apply changes to `develop`

issues.title: Provide JSON-Editor with component to view/render location data
issues.body:
Our planning messages include `slugs` of JSON for the shapes(lines, polygons, etc).

JSON-Editor tries to build up a set of controls for this array data, but it  ends up with loads of ugly components:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/199804239-fa39ba46-dbe0-408e-b5e9-0e42f696b6fa.png)


I don't know the best solution, but this is the best I can think of:
- convert the JSON for `location` to a string
- specify in the template, that `location` is of `type`: `string`, but with a `format` of `location` [*]
- provide JSON-editor with a custom component for `format`: `location` entries
- display the geometries as `<ol>` `<li>` entries, showing the `properties.name`, and the `geometry.type`
- include an `edit` button, which will _eventually_ allow the player to edit the shapes

An example of providing a custom component to json-editor is given here: https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor/blob/8f2b5ec5ca5787b3cd1c6b83ee3ec2ef29aeb34c/src/editors/starrating.js

A story to develop this against is "ready to go" here: http://localhost:6611/?path=/story/local-molecules-jsoneditor--planning-message

[*] by doing this, json-editor no longer tries to create a tree of controls to represent the JSON data. I _think_ it also prepares JSON-Editor to use a custom `string` editor component.

Maybe an editor component like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/200586842-a55076d0-1669-4da2-b51d-91571e676af5.png)

comments.body:
@lebaphi provided a workaround for this, which works quite well so far:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/200782365-77970259-c5f9-494a-82db-28cf7737cddb.png)

But, in the longer term, I'm still interested in providing a custom editor component to `json-editor`.  

The `json-editor` control is currently extensible to use custom components. I think they are largely different `format` values for a `type: "string"` field in the schema.  The star-rating component linked to above is an example of this.

I think that's our future path.

Ok, there's a description of how to integrate a new editor component in the `json-editor` documentation here:
https://github.com/json-editor/json-editor#custom-editor-interfaces

I propose we start simply, and progress steadily:
- simple label showing text content
- has function that can convert JSON content to human-readable
- has advanced function that can do lookup from JSON data in array of reference data
- has "Edit location" button that can call method passing data, with callback function for results (or null for cancel)
